name: Specula
cardMetric: Shutterless camera scan · live Excel sheet
impactSummary: Turns receipt data entry into holding a receipt up to a camera. Specula captures on its own when the frame is steady and sharp, reads it with Gemini, and adds a row to a live spreadsheet that downloads as Excel, so paper never has to be typed in again.
desc: A receipt scanner that skips the shutter button. Live camera mode works on a phone or a laptop webcam: an on-device gate captures only steady, in-focus, new frames, so every model call counts. Gemini reads the merchant, line items, tax and total into schema-validated JSON in about 3 seconds, and each receipt lands in a live, editable sheet with .xlsx export. Scan a pairing QR with your phone and its scans appear on the laptop's sheet within seconds, on any network.
metric: Shutterless live capture · ~3s receipt read · Live sheet → .xlsx · QR phone-to-laptop pairing
sceneAlt: Field engineer in a hi-vis vest pointing a phone at a motor nameplate; the screen lists the extracted fields

name: RAG Knowledge Assistant
impactSummary: Eliminated hallucination in engineering doc search, achieving 99.4% faithfulness across 15 benchmark suites with verifiable source page citations, lowering support query resolution time.
desc: Retrieval pipeline that answers from engineering documentation instead of guessing: semantic chunking, FAISS dense search, cross-encoder reranking, and answers that cite the page they came from. Evaluated across 15 benchmarks for recall@k, faithfulness, and latency.
metric: 99.4% citation faithfulness · Semantic chunking → FAISS → cross-encoder rerank
sceneAlt: Engineer's bench with a laptop answering from the manual, the open manual full of sticky tabs, and a torque wrench

name: RushDailyBot
impactSummary: Automated morning priority digests and voice memo triage, cutting daily executive context-switching time with sub-400ms Telegram voice responses and continuous n8n webhook sync.
desc: A 24/7 personal executive assistant on Telegram. Handles morning briefings, parses voice memos and links with Gemini, tracks daily priorities into Obsidian, and digests market setups.
metric: Sub-400ms response · 24/7 cron dispatch · n8n webhook sync · Supabase memory
sceneAlt: Phone showing the morning brief on a kitchen counter beside a steaming cup of coffee at sunrise

name: ReybinEye PM
impactSummary: Reduced site inspection and diagnostic overhead by over 40% across 28 live surveillance camera nodes with automated checklist verification, BOM inventory tracking, and simulated device RTSP telemetry.
desc: Systems integration and project management platform for mission-critical CCTV deployments: milestone tracking, automated site inspection checklists, BOM inventory allocation, and simulated device telemetry (FPS, bitrate, RTSP health). Demo sanitized for confidentiality.
metric: 40%+ inspection time cut · 28 nodes tracked · 100% synthetic demo · NDA compliant
sceneAlt: Technician in a reflective vest checking an inspection list on a tablet in front of an apron CCTV wall at night

name: Rush Voice Butler
impactSummary: Delivered 100% private, zero-cloud speech processing directly on edge Raspberry Pi 4 hardware, operating reliably without external API dependencies or data leakage risks.
desc: Always-listening voice butler running fully on-device: Vosk STT + Piper neural TTS, Spotify Connect, and a Telegram & n8n bridge. 100% on-device speech privacy.
metric: 100% speech privacy · 99.9% local uptime · <280ms local speech pipeline
sceneAlt: Raspberry Pi in a clear case with a microphone and speaker on a bookshelf under a dimmed desk lamp

name: emman.pi
impactSummary: Built a fully procedural 3D digital-twin PCB portfolio rendering at 60 FPS in WebGL, integrated with edge-cached state and prompt-injection guarded Gemini butler.
desc: An interactive 3D Raspberry Pi 5 portfolio built from scratch with React Three Fiber, backed by Cloudflare Pages Functions for a Gemini AI butler with prompt-injection guards, KV persistence, and bearer-authenticated webhooks from Telegram and n8n.
metric: 100% procedural 3D · 60 FPS WebGL · Edge Functions + KV · Prompt injection guards
sceneAlt: Laptop rendering a 3D Raspberry Pi 5 with the real board on the desk in front of it

name: Bridgely
impactSummary: Engineered polyglot orchestrator connecting NestJS, DeepSeek AI, Cloudflare D1, MongoDB, and PHP 8.2 compliance export, achieving seamless cross-stack interoperability.
desc: Recruiter intake that fans one submission across four services: a Nest.js orchestrator writes identity to Cloudflare D1, DeepSeek builds a structured skills matrix, MongoDB files the evaluation, and a PHP 8.2 service round-trips it as compliance XML.
metric: 10-step orchestration across 4 services · D1 + MongoDB + legacy XML compliance
sceneAlt: Recruiter in a Manila office reviewing a candidate pipeline and skills matrix on a large monitor

name: EvalGate
impactSummary: Prevented silent prompt regressions from reaching production by gating every system prompt edit against a deterministic 10-case evaluation suite (regex, exact label, and keyword contracts) with sub-2ms local verification.
desc: Prompt regression harness that gates every system prompt change against a fixed case set before deployment. Runs side-by-side Baseline vs. Candidate prompt diffs, enforces a strict minimum pass threshold (min = 0.90), and blocks CI builds when previously passing assertions regress.
metric: 0.90 min pass threshold · Prompt A/B regression diff · Zero-dependency TypeScript & Web Workbench
sceneAlt: Software engineer at an industrial desk reviewing a dark-mode prompt evaluation matrix with green PASS badges and an orange 0.90 threshold line
